device.description: quadruple 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 4-wire serial interface (CS, FS), LDAC and power down
device.note: slas188b.pdf (SLAS188B) p.1 pinout, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 timing requirements and Figure 1, p.12-13 serial interface and data format, p.14 DAC select

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A input latch (A1 A0 = 0); power-on reset all zero (p.12)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B input latch (A1 A0 = 1); power-on reset all zero (p.12)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C input latch (A1 A0 = 2); power-on reset all zero (p.12)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D input latch (A1 A0 = 3); power-on reset all zero (p.12)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A latch, loaded while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B latch, loaded while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C latch, loaded while LDAC is low

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D latch, loaded while LDAC is low

registers.name: CTRLA
registers.note: DAC A individual control bits PWR (1 = power down) and SPD (1 = fast) from the data word

registers.name: CTRLB
registers.note: DAC B individual control bits PWR (1 = power down) and SPD (1 = fast) from the data word

registers.name: CTRLC
registers.note: DAC C individual control bits PWR (1 = power down) and SPD (1 = fast) from the data word

registers.name: CTRLD
registers.note: DAC D individual control bits PWR (1 = power down) and SPD (1 = fast) from the data word

commands.name: Write DAC A
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D0 = new DAC value (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC B
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D0 = new DAC value (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC C
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D0 = new DAC value (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC D
commands.note: D15-D14 = A1 A0, D13 = PWR, D12 = SPD, D11-D0 = new DAC value (p.13-14)

protocol.note: FS falling starts a 16-bit frame (CS must be low); bits sampled on SCLK falling edges, SCLK idles high (Figure 1, p.7) -> mode 2; after 16 bits (or FS rising) the word is moved to the selected DAC's latch

ldac.note: LDAC high: no DAC output updates; outputs follow while LDAC is low (p.3)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions), p.7 (timing), p.12-14 (serial interface, data format, DAC select)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs (x2 buffer), reference inputs REFINAB / REFINCD
CS is not modeled: FS is the frame pin of the model (CS must be held low, as in the p.13 three-wire connection); in four-wire use CS high would ignore FS frames
FS rising before 16 bits ends a frame early and updates the DAC with a partial word; the model drops short frames
PD pin (active low, powers down all DACs) and per-DAC PWR / SPD bits: analog only, stored only
the -EP datasheet (tlv5614-ep.pdf, TLV5614MPWREP) describes the same chip
variants: TLV5614MPWREP: enhanced-product version (tlv5614-ep.pdf), same pinout and interface
